# mimecast_journaling_services (Data Source)

Read all journaling services with cursor pagination, including every non-secret connection and status field. Passwords are never decoded into this surface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_journaling_services" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the service is enabled.
- `id` (String) Journaling service ID.
- `journal_non_internal_addresses` (Boolean) Whether non-internal addresses are journalled.
- `journal_unknown_internal_addresses` (Boolean) Whether unknown internal addresses are journalled.
- `last_received_date_time` (String) Time the last journal message was received.
- `message_format` (String) Journal message format.
- `pop3_detailed_logging_is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether detailed POP3 logging is enabled.
- `pop3_email_address` (String, Sensitive) POP3 journaling email address.
- `pop3_encryption_is_relaxed` (Boolean) Whether relaxed POP3 certificate validation is enabled.
- `pop3_host` (String) POP3 server host.
- `pop3_mailbox` (String, Sensitive) POP3 mailbox username.
- `pop3_port` (Number) POP3 server port.
- `pop3_uses_pop3s` (Boolean) Whether POP3S is used.
- `queue_size` (Number) Current queue size.
- `remove_journal_headers` (Boolean) Whether Exchange journal headers are removed.
- `smtp_delivery_wait_attempts` (Number) Delivery wait attempts.
- `smtp_email_address` (String, Sensitive) SMTP journaling email address.
- `smtp_extended_deduplication` (Boolean) Whether extended deduplication is enabled.
- `smtp_hostnames` (List of String) SMTP connector hostnames.
- `smtp_inactivity_timeout` (Number) SMTP inactivity timeout.
- `smtp_ip_ranges` (List of String) Permitted SMTP source IP ranges.
- `smtp_prefers_clear_text` (Boolean) Whether clear text is preferred.
- `smtp_process_initial_delay` (Number) SMTP process initial delay.
- `smtp_uses_authentication` (Boolean) Whether SMTP authentication is used.
- `smtp_uses_tls` (Boolean) Whether SMTP uses TLS.
- `status` (String) Service status.
- `transfer_protocol` (String) Transfer protocol.
